coordinate: Branches 子=0..亥=11; stem 甲=0..癸=9; all placement arithmetic modulo 12.

profile.name: Explicit half-month leap convention plus unmodified Chang/Qu day-count verse
profile.school: Selected 中州派 half-month convention combined with named published placement verses; no all-school certification or complete independent program lineage claimed.
profile.calendar: Explicit lunar year/month/day, algorithmSex, yearStem/yearBranch and hourBranch; no solar conversion or lunar-date existence/length validation.
profile.leapMonth: Use independent base effectiveLunarMonth: leap day 1..15 nominal month, 16..30 next month, retaining original lunar day. Effective month 13 wraps to month 1 for the four month tables.
profile.earlyDays: For 恩光/天贵 apply (文昌/文曲 + lunarDay - 2) mod 12 also on days 1 and 2. This is verse-derived arithmetic, not an attested day-1/day-2 special-case ruling.

dependencyHashPolicy: Each result carries SHA-256 of the exact bytes of all five dependency files, including this metadata file and the new reference code. No self-referential hash is embedded in this file.
